name: 2019 High Volume FHV Trip Records
description:
This dataset contains a 5,000-row sample of 2019 trip records for high-volume for-hire vehicles (FHV), such as app-based ride services operating in New York City. Each row represents a single completed trip and includes the vehicle license number, the dispatching base number, pickup and drop-off timestamps, and pickup and drop-off taxi zone location IDs. A shared-ride flag (sr_flag) is also included but is populated for only about 23% of rows, with all recorded values equal to 1.

The data supports analysis of trip timing and duration, demand patterns by time of day, and origin-destination flows between zones. It can be used to map popular pickup and drop-off areas, compare activity across licensed operators and dispatching bases, estimate travel times, and study shared-ride usage. Because the file is a sample rather than the full 2019 record set, it is best suited for exploration, visualization, and prototyping rather than precise volume counts
